assumptions: Competitor pricing and changelog pages are public and change without notice, so live cases assert the report's structure and status against a stated project history, not specific prices.
Earlier reports under reports/competitor-watch/ are the only history. A case that needs history states which earlier report the project holds.
Search competitors from organic.keyword_plan and ads.assessment are overlap-based suggestions; the run confirms each one sells to the same buyer before watching it.
cost_drivers: One bounded Codex session under the existing procedure ceiling, with no managed-model routes and no connected-provider calls.
Web actions: at most 30 per run, driven by max_competitors (1 to 5) and up to four pages each. A weekly run with recorded page URLs costs less than the first run.
effects: Writes one run-owned reports/competitor-watch/<run_id>.md in project state.

Reads earlier reports/competitor-watch/ reports, reports/GROWTH_ONBOARDING_PLAN.md, wiki/INDEX.md, reports/keyword-plan/*/evidence.json, reports/paid-ads/*/assessment.json and public web pages through fenced web access.
No sign-up, sign-in, form submission, contact, publication, memory edit or workflow start.

rubric.question: Does the report list only changes against the previous evidence block, with before -> after and the source page, rather than restating the competitor's site?
Is every suggested response tied to a material change listed under What changed, and does a week with no material change say 'Nothing needs a response this week' with no table?
Is impact judged against the project's own plans from the Feature map, Code map or onboarding plan (or the stated override), citing where it came from?
Does each suggested response name a real Tin workflow (content.plan or research.deep_dive) with concrete inputs, and none that a hard no rules out?
Is every page that was not read listed under Not read with its status, and was nothing filled in from snippets or memory?

cases.description: A project with a Feature map and no earlier competitor watch. The founder supplies one competitor's pricing and changelog URLs. Expect a baseline with a pricing table and an evidence block.

inputs.watch_for: A cheaper entry plan or a free tier with more seats.

cases.description: No URLs given. The project holds a succeeded keyword plan whose evidence.json lists three search competitors, one of which is a review site. Expect the review site dropped and the others watched with source keyword_plan.
The project holds last week's report for the same competitor and nothing on its pricing page changed. Expect silence: no-change, no response table, pricing unchanged since the earlier date.

contains: Nothing needs a response this week.

cases.description: Plausible but unusable page: last week's report holds a read pricing page; this week the pricing page returns only a JavaScript shell with no plans. Expect the page listed as empty under Not read, pricing carried forward and not compared, and no invented tier removals or responses.
Plausible but unusable history: the only earlier report has a truncated tin-competitor-watch block. Expect it skipped and named under Not read, and this run treated as a baseline rather than diffed.
No URLs, no earlier watch, no onboarding plan competitors, no keyword plan or paid-ads assessment. Expect a diagnostic naming both ways forward and no evidence block.
